snippet.title: One More Rock! - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for One More Rock!, a mining incremental game developed by Puff Fugu. Players will set out to mine, gamble, and forge until the sun rises to attain upgrades along the way. One More Rock! is coming soon to PC (Steam).
